classification: prespecified toy development experiment, not confirmation
selection: initialization minimum mean training loss; no later selection or rejection
freshness: distinct deterministic seeds per phase and generation, exposed after execution
budget: every arm receives the same eight meta-objective evaluations per generation; unused evaluations are explicitly charged waste; random displacement norm matches self displacement from that arm's own parent
claim: separate exact reconstruction, self-application, and fresh-target utility; do not infer RSI or AGI
